component.name: Cursus
component.summary: Private SimpleX messenger for Linux desktops and phones

description.p: Cursus is a native client for the SimpleX Chat network, built on the official SimpleX core. It adapts to desktop windows and phone screens (touch, on-screen keyboard).

ul.li: End-to-end encrypted chats, groups and channels without user IDs
App lock, hidden notification text and IP protection for file downloads
Chats, groups and channels with replies, reactions, voice messages and files
Layouts for desktop windows and phones (touch, on-screen keyboard)
Encrypted database and attachments; decrypted media never kept after quitting
App lock, unlock via system keyring, hidden notification text, IP protection for downloads
